scripts.up:all: npm run up:dev && npm run up:monitoring
scripts.db-seed: cd backend/timescaledb-env && docker compose run --rm db-seed
scripts.install: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:backend:report: cd backend && uv run ruff check . --output-format=json --output-file=backend-lint-report.json
scripts.lint:frontend:report: cd frontend && npx eslint --ext .js,.ts,.vue . --format json --output-file frontend-lint-report.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run pytest weather/tests/unit --junitxml=backend-test-report.xml
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
